g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Traced from photos of board KB3151C (XWW speed controller, 110-120V 1.0A).

g.desc: Traced from photos of board KB3151C (XWW speed controller, 110-120V 1.0A).

g.text: Q1 tab is MT2 (live). J1/J2 are the spade tabs; the board is a 2-terminal switch in series with the motor.

g.desc: Q1 tab is MT2 (live). J1/J2 are the spade tabs; the board is a 2-terminal switch in series with the motor.

g.text: VERIFY: RV2 wiper tied to its pin-3 end; RV1 pin-1 and R3 to the MT2 tab; which RV1 pin is the wiper.

g.desc: VERIFY: RV2 wiper tied to its pin-3 end; RV1 pin-1 and R3 to the MT2 tab; which RV1 pin is the wiper.

g.text: Moving toward pin 1, R falls toward 0 and speed rises; RV2 caps R (sets the slowest speed) just past the off zone.

g.desc: Moving toward pin 1, R falls toward 0 and speed rises; RV2 caps R (sets the slowest speed) just past the off zone.

g.text: RV2 lies across RV1's whole track (pin 1 to pin 3). RV1 off zone at the pin-3 end: wiper open, no firing.

g.desc: RV2 lies across RV1's whole track (pin 1 to pin 3). RV1 off zone at the pin-3 end: wiper open, no firing.

g.text: C2 voltage fires D1 through R1 into the gate. R3 + C1 are the snubber across the triac.

g.desc: C2 voltage fires D1 through R1 into the gate. R3 + C1 are the snubber across the triac.

g.text: Timing: MT2 -> RV1 pin-1 section, in parallel with (RV2 + RV1 pin-3 section) -> wiper -> R2 -> C2 -> MT1.

g.desc: Timing: MT2 -> RV1 pin-1 section, in parallel with (RV2 + RV1 pin-3 section) -> wiper -> R2 -> C2 -> MT1.
